parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: Two complete cosine oscillations from $(0,3)$ to $(2\pi,3)$, together with the straight line from $(0,\frac52)$ to $(2\pi,-\frac12)$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Only mark the curve from $0$ to $2\pi$. If the $x$-axis is not labelled, assume the range shown is $0$ to $2\pi$. Labels on axes are not required.
Two complete oscillations of a cosine curve starting with a maximum at $(0,a)$, $a>0$. — B1.
Fully correct curve, which must appear to level off at $0$ and/or $2\pi$. — B1.
A straight line starting on the positive $y$-axis and finishing below the $x$-axis at $2\pi$. — B1.
Total: 3
